name: Estrid
source:
[spoiler]Henri's maid. Given to him by Athagan. Likes to be spanked. A lot.[/spoiler] Raised in Athagan's household since she was a teenager.

Her mother was a Nord warchief, and was killed when her ship floundered. 

[In game description]
